MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD card fits my repeated purchases of removable storage, adapters, and a card reader; spare storage would support devices I already use.",
    "The HDMI cable could be useful for my TV setup, provided its connections and length match what I need. Its practical connection role matters more to me than its 4K capability."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and display introduce voice-assistant and video-calling uses that my accessory purchases do not suggest I currently need.",
    "Owning a TV and recently buying a DVD player does not mean I want streaming hardware, and 4K adds little for my listed 720p TV.",
    "The older Fire tablet duplicates a device I already own and have equipped with a case, rather than helping me use that device."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire 7 purchase seems to have been taken as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, although my related purchases were storage and accessories.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in entertainment gadgets, when I usually choose items that serve a specific practical need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, card holders, adapters, and a reader show an ongoing need to store, organize, and transfer files.",
    "My tripods, tablet mount, and recent lens cap point toward supporting my existing camera and device setup.",
    "Compatibility and whether I already own an equipped device matter: a useful accessory can fit my needs better than another device with overlapping functions."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and connection needs but read my device ownership as a desire for more entertainment and Alexa devices."
}
